scoring.abstention_policy: excluded from means; never zeroed or imputed

bootstrap.scheme: paired; for specificity the same resampled prompt IDs are applied jointly to the real arm and all five random arms
bootstrap.seed_uncertainty: reported separately as sd/min/max across the five seed-level point estimates; seeds are never treated as prompt-level observations

no_p_value: no formal randomization-test p-value is computed, by protocol
